arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Grossman argued the statute bans any deceptive device in securities trades.
Mr. Shapiro argued the investors seek to expand an implied cause of action.
Mr. Hungar argued the lower court correctly applied prior precedent.
Mr. Grossman questioned why a contract existed if the advertising cost nothing.
